headline: The satellite ferry gets its arcade debut
lede: Missile Command's wave-6 ferry is now the game it reads as on a phone: orange cruise trails, a crunch that outranks a warhead boom, a wreck that sparks, and a ferry that crosses the attract screen to advertise itself — with a new reserve rule that makes the expert bonus shot provably free.

notes.text: Reserve rule: the watch spends a shell on the 125-point ferry only when what stays covers every warhead still to come. A/B sweep across 12 seeds and waves 6–10: the bonus never costs a city, waves 6–8 always pay, and at waves 9–10 it lets the ferry go rather than gamble.
Kill juice, era-correct: the burn pops a white flash plus six falling debris sparks; dice roll only on kills, so the wave 1–5 byte pins never move.
Legibility at phone scale: hull and dome enlarged, rim lights thickened, cruise trails set orange 2px against ICBM red — judged on device-scale-1 screenshots and pinned by pixel probes.
The attract screen now advertises the feature: a scripted ferry (by tick, not dice) crosses the demo board and the attract pilot leads it.

look.text: Shoot the ferry for 125 — flash, sparks, crunch
